title_candidates: Anthropic's agent security lessons start with limiting access
summary: Anthropic documented how it contains Claude across chat, coding, and knowledge-work products, with practical lessons for anyone giving an AI agent access to files and tools.

primary_source.title: How we contain Claude across products
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Anthropic uses different containment architectures for Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork.
Users approved roughly 93 percent of Claude Code permission prompts.
Hard environmental boundaries limit damage when behavior checks or approvals fail.

prerequisites: An AI agent that can access files, connectors, or websites
A folder containing non-sensitive test files

steps.instruction: Run a bounded agent task inside a separate test folder with unnecessary connectors disabled.
